summary: Tests-writing (red) phase for issue #5, completed across two commits (445fcf4, bca0cf1). Committed: green wire-format pins served by a URLProtocol stub (APIClientContractTests; APIClientTests with stub fixtures matching the published spec's response shapes) and red tests driving the implementation run (vendored OpenAPI 3 document presence, six-surface path coverage, per-operation success status + JSON body + JSON request body + bearerAuth security, schema title/enum/required pins) plus Package.swift wiring pins for swift-openapi-generator + swift-openapi-runtime + OpenAPIGeneratorPlugin. Every contract delta in docs/openapi-client-migration.md was re-verified this run against upstream sources (api_schemas.ex, capture_controller.ex, test_sheet_controller.ex, router.ex at viamin/color_matching main, PR #113). The vendored-spec and package-wiring criteria fail today as expected missing behavior; swift test could not run in this container (no Swift toolchain) and must be exercised on macOS CI / the implementation run.

acceptance_criteria.description: Add swift-openapi-generator + swift-openapi-runtime to the iOS package; fetch or vendor the OpenAPI document from viamin/color_matching#110

references.detail: testPackageManifestUsesOpenAPIGeneratorPlugin — Package.swift contains neither swift-openapi-generator nor OpenAPIGeneratorPlugin (expected red: wiring is implementation phase)
testPackageManifestLinksOpenAPIRuntime — Package.swift lacks swift-openapi-runtime (expected red)
testVendoredOpenAPIDocumentExists — OpenAPIDocumentError.notVendored; iOS/OpenAPI/color-matching-openapi.json not vendored yet (expected red)

acceptance_criteria.description: Generate the client for the surfaces the app uses today: manifest, recent sheets, capture creation, measurement upload, judgment upload, ranked results

references.detail: testVendoredSpecCoversEveryAppSurface — pins the six path/method pairs incl. GET /api/v1/test_sheets/{sheet_id}/ranked_results; fails while the spec is not vendored (expected red)

testEveryAppOperationDeclaresSpecSuccessStatusWithJSONBody — pins 200 for reads/uploads and 201 for capture creation with application/json bodies (verified against upstream capture_controller.ex/test_sheet_controller.ex); expected red
testUploadOperationsDeclareJSONRequestBody — POSTs declare application/json request bodies; expected red
testEveryAppOperationRequiresBearerAuth — per-operation security [{bearerAuth: []}] pinned from upstream controllers; expected red
testSpecDefinesSchemasForAppPayloads — pins the nine upstream schema titles; expected red
testManifestSchemaPinsCompatibilityVersions — enum pins lps-sheet-manifest/v1 and lps-distance-v1; expected red

testUploadResponsesDeclareJSONBodiesProseContractAssumedEmpty — pins MeasurementUploadResponse {capture_id, measurement_count, pair_score_count} and JudgmentUploadResponse {capture_id, judgment_count} required sets; expected red
testCaptureRequestAcceptsNestedMetadataQualityShape — anyOf branch requiring [:metadata] plus quality property, the shape the app sends; expected red

acceptance_criteria.description: Replace the app's hand-written API models with generated types; keep purely client-side models as-is

references.detail: testFetchManifestDecodesProseContractFixture — green-by-design wire pin; could not be executed here (no Swift toolchain); exercises the manifest surface the generated types must keep satisfying
testCreateCaptureEncodesMetadataAndQuality — stub now serves the spec's 201 + numeric-string capture_id so the same fixture exercises the generated client's decoded CaptureCreatedResponse

testManifestRequiredFieldsMatchUpstreamUnderSpecification — drift alarm: fails if upstream expands TestSheetManifest, forcing regeneration and moving geometry fields from client-side models to generated types; expected red now
Records which manifest geometry fields are absent from the published spec and therefore stay client-side models (SheetManifest/Patch/PairManifest) until upstream expands TestSheetManifest

verification.note: Model replacement itself is the implementation run; a compile-safe client-call test for ranked_results is not expressible until the generated module exists (no callable symbol today).

acceptance_criteria.description: Swift tests exercising the generated client against local stubbed responses (no live server in CI)

references.detail: URLProtocol-based stub serving fixtures with no network dependency; the harness the generated-client tests will use
Measurement/judgment upload stubs now serve the spec's 200 count bodies (MeasurementUploadResponse/JudgmentUploadResponse), forward-compatible with the generated client that decodes them
Judgment upload stub uses the numeric-string capture id flow (42) the server issues

verification.note: Generated-client call tests cannot compile before the generated module exists (compile-time dependency); stub fixtures and harness are in place; tracked for the implementation run.

acceptance_criteria.description: PR description records what changed between the prose contract and the published spec, and endpoint gaps discovered

references.detail: Eight verified deltas (manifest under-specification incl. exact required set, ranked-results schema minimal, measurement upload drops top-level scoring_algorithm_version / requires normalized_linear_rgb_median / stats undocumented, upload bodies 200 JSON with exact required fields instead of empty 204, capture_id numeric string with non-integer 404, enums not machine-visible, recent sheets parity incl. required-but-nullable title, bearerAuth per-operation) plus endpoint gaps. Each fact re-verified this run against upstream api_schemas.ex / capture_controller.ex / test_sheet_controller.ex / router.ex fetched from viamin/color_matching main (PR #113). Content destined verbatim for the PR description.

acceptance_criteria.description: Exit criterion: swift test --disable-sandbox green with generated types wired in

references.detail: macOS CI runs swift test on PRs

verification.reason: This container has no Swift toolchain (swift: command not found), so swift test could not be executed. Red-phase assertion failures are the intended demonstration of missing behavior; compile/runtime verification must happen in CI or the implementation run.
